name: weekly-review
title: Accessibility weekly review
subtitle: Synthetic demo records. Evidence review, not a conformance score.

sections.title: Critical journeys
sections.sql: select code,site,title,owner,state,due_on from v_findings where critical and state not in ('resolved','accepted') order by code

sections.title: What needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by reason,code

sections.title: Site review
sections.sql: select code,name,open_findings,accepted_findings,last_manual_audit,review_on from v_site_review order by code

sections.title: Fixes needing another look
sections.sql: select code,title,fixed_by,latest_result,stale_test,state from v_findings where fix_id is not null and state<>'resolved' order by code

sections.title: Accepted and expired risks
sections.sql: select code,title,exception_reason,expires_on,state from v_findings where exception_id is not null order by code

sections.title: Open work by owner
sections.sql: select coalesce(nullif(owner,''),'Unassigned') as owner,count(*)::int as findings,count(*) filter(where due_on<current_date)::int as overdue from v_findings where state not in ('resolved','accepted') group by owner order by overdue desc
